name: mofa-publish
content_type_description: Deploy a built static site to GitHub Pages or Mac Mini hosting. Handles repo creation, branch setup, file transfer, and verification. Returns the live URL.
author: hagency
description: Deploy a built static site to GitHub Pages or Mac Mini hosting and verify the live URL.

discovery.summary: Publishes a built static site to GitHub Pages or a Mac Mini and verifies the live URL.

hints.when: user wants to deploy to GitHub Pages or asks about `gh-pages` / `.nojekyll`
user wants to deploy to a Mac Mini (mini1/mini3) or asks about the public Mini URL
SSH auth fails or user needs `--ssh-key` / `--ssh-password-env` / non-22 port flags
user wants CI auto-deploy on push (`setup_ci`) or a custom domain (CNAME)
site is a dynamic Node app (not a static export) and needs a reverse proxy on Mini
user wants a sample Caddy reverse-proxy block for `/sites/<slug>/` or a dedicated subdomain
user is unsure which framework output dir to point at (Quarto/Astro/Next/plain HTML)
user wants the dual-deploy (public GitHub + private Mini) pattern or pipeline-stage overview

tools.name: mofa_publish
tools.spawn_only_message: SUCCESS: Site deployment is now running in background. The live URL will be reported when the deploy completes. No further action needed for this request.
tools.description: Deploy a built static site to GitHub Pages or Mac Mini hosting. Handles repo creation, branch setup, Pages configuration, file transfer, and verification. NOT for site generation — use `mofa_site` for site creation. Runs in background — do NOT wait for it.

site_dir.description: Path to built static site directory (must contain index.html)

slug.description: Deployment name. For GitHub Pages this should usually match the repo basename; for Mini it becomes the /sites/<slug>/ path.

repo.description: GitHub repo in owner/name format (required for github-pages target). The public Pages URL is derived from this repo name.

repo_root.description: Optional local repository root where the generated deploy workflow should also be written when setup_ci is true

mini_host.description: Which Mac Mini to deploy to (mini target only)

mini_user.description: SSH username for the mini target

ssh_key.description: Optional SSH private key path for the mini target

ssh_password_env.description: Optional environment variable name containing the SSH password for the mini target. Uses sshpass when set.

ssh_port.description: SSH port for the mini target

remote_root.description: Remote web root for the mini target. Defaults to /Users/<mini_user>/octos-web

setup_ci.description: Generate GitHub Actions workflow for auto-deploy on push. Publishes the workflow to GitHub and optionally mirrors it into repo_root.
